resources.string: Checkers
Move your pieces diagonally on the dark squares and jump over the computer’s pieces to capture them. Reach the far side to get a king. Take all its pieces or leave it without moves to win.
Brazilian checkers
8×8. Men also capture backwards, kings move far, and you must take the most pieces.
International draughts
10×10 board with 20 pieces each. Same rules as Brazilian checkers.
English checkers
8×8, also called American checkers. Men go only forwards, kings move one square, dark starts.
Italian checkers
8×8. Men cannot capture kings, kings move one square, and you must take the most pieces.
Russian checkers
8×8. Kings move far, you may choose any capture, and a man crowned while capturing goes on as a king.
